messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy 'micronudge-v2' finished -> prod at 2025-11-02T10:12:34Z. Observability alert: /v1/generate p95 from ~120ms -> 2.1s, p99 ~6.4s, 5xx rate increasing (gateway timeouts). Canary traffic=5% on route inference-gateway-us-west. Metrics: https://observ.redwood/ops/graphs/abcd1234

alice (oncall): seeing same. Paging SRE. @bob you free?

bob (sre): on it. pulling traces and trace-summary. Any recent kernel flags or runtime knob changes in this canary?

charlie (eng): this canary included a small KV affinity change and a batching micro-tweak (micronudge) plus new kernel selector heuristics. No infra flags. commit: abc123 -> build 20251102-1700

sre-bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/timeout-regression. Suggested checks: 1) compare canary vs baseline latency distro 2) check kvcache hit rate 3) check batch size distribution

alice (oncall): quick checks: kvcache hit rate for micronudge-v2 = 42% (baseline v1 ~71%). batch sizes spiked to median 8 -> 32 for some shards.

bob (sre): logs show a cluster of long-tail stalls on downstream model-inference pods: repeated CONNRESET and grpc deadline-exceeded between gateway -> runtime. Sample trace: `gateway -> runtime-a -> runtime-b (KV miss) -> retry -> timeout`.

charlie (eng): that aligns with the kvcache drop. The micronudge batching tweak increases routing to fewer hot workers; if kvcache cold, KV lookups are heavier. Could amplify tail.

alice (oncall): customer impact? Support: any spikes in error messages?

dana (product): CS reports a handful of customer errors (timeouts) from high-volume accounts; not platform-wide but noticeable. Flagging potential SLA exposure.

bob (sre): given p99 ~6.4s and rising 5xx, and canary is 5% traffic, recommend immediate rollback of canary to stop rollforward. We can fail-open to fallback model but rollback is fastest.

charlie (eng): agreed. Initiating rollback to micronudge-v1. Command:```bash
# rollback via deploy system
rwi deploy rollback --service inference-gateway --from-revision abc123 --to-revision abc122 --confirm
```

deploy-bot: rollback job started by charlie at 2025-11-02T10:13:12Z. Job id: rb-7123

sre-bot: Notifying PagerDuty and Support. PD: paging alice, bob, charlie. Support notify: incident created RN-7123.

alice (oncall): running quick smoke against /v1/generate on prod (50 reqs) 

(small pause)

alice (oncall): smoke after rollback start: 50 reqs -> 0 timeouts, median 140ms, p95 180ms, p99 420ms. Looks like rollback is helping.

bob (sre): metrics confirming: gateway 5xx rate back down to baseline within 30s of rollback. kvcache hit rate climbing back to ~69%.

deploy-bot: rollback rb-7123 completed at 2025-11-02T10:13:56Z. Service stable.

charlie (eng): thanks. Leaving this open for telemetry for another 10m. We should capture pre/post traces and a reproducible test to validate batching interaction.

dana (product): marking customer-impact = moderate. Will coordinate comms with CS if we see more reports.

bob (sre): short-term mitigations: revert batching change in canary config, add stricter kvcache drop threshold to abort canary rollout, autoscaler playbook to scale hot-workers faster. Long-term: add pre-warm logic for new routing heuristic.

alice (oncall): handoff: I have ~25m left on rotation. Next on-call charlie will take postmortem ownership. Charlie?

charlie (eng): ack, I'll own postmortem. Immediate action items: 1) collect full traces for canary window 10:11:30-10:13:30 2) run a synthetic workload that stresses KV cold paths to reproduce 3) add canary guardrail for kvcache <60% -> abort.

sre-bot: Created incident ticket INCIDENT-7123, severity: P1 (customer-facing latency). Added stakeholders: eng-runtime, eng-ml, product.

alice (oncall): re: customer comms: Dana, can you draft a short note for CS summarizing rollback and mitigation? include timeframe and affected endpoints.

dana (product): on it. Drafting now and will send to CS for approval.

charlie (eng): quick note for the postmortem: possible root cause hypothesis = batching heuristic change + KV cold-warm imbalance -> amplification of tail latency. Need reproduction test.

bob (sre): closing on-call pager in 45m if no regression. Will keep alert thresholds slightly tightened for 2 hours.

alice (oncall): confirmed. Adding retrospective on runbook: add explicit canary kvcache metric check and a tighter p99 threshold for inference-gateway. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Handoff: incident owner charlie, postmortem due EOD+2. Next oncall: charlie (in 25m). Incident will remain open until postmortem is filed.

charlie (eng): filing initial notes and will ping channel when postmortem draft ready. Thanks all for quick actions.

alice (oncall): nice work. Closing thread once postmortem link posted. :white_check_mark:
